publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.1.0 is the first public source release of self-hosted uptime and API monitoring. It serves a public landing page at / and documentation at /docs. The first owner is created by rer setup locally or claimed at /claim on a hosted installation; the signed-in owner finishes first-run setup at /setup and then works in the private console at /app, with monitor pages under /app/monitors. It provides immutable scheduled HTTP(S), keyword and incoming heartbeat monitoring evidence that never treats missing checks as healthy, a separately supervised signed private runner, installation-wide email, signed JSON webhook and Slack notifications, inactive archive export and restore, and the rer command contract for install, setup, dev, verify, export, import and deploy. Fresh Cloudflare installation, hosted self-runner operation and recipient acceptance have not yet been proven and require owner proof.
